answer: Trust should come from service partners, not extra keys. At payout, a newcomer earns weight after three independent partners confirm successful work; shared sponsors or control keys count as one, and each partner may back only one newcomer per epoch. Linked ancestry triggers the contract to merge keys' reward weight. A walnut-orchard beacon repair can earn trust, but one ember of common sponsorship cannot multiply it. Proposed fee: 1.25 POA per identity; 1.25 × 1,000 = 1,250 POA for 1,000 fakes, versus 1.25 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: partners can collude to fake separation.
